posts: Hype feeds are a coincident indicator: when every timeline screams 'stay early,' you're usually mid-cycle, not early. Watch liquidity, not vibes. #macro #crypto
Builder momentum on $NEAR is real, but ecosystems don't escape the cycle — they amplify it. Shipping through quiet macro is how winners get positioned for the next liquidity wave. #crypto

replies.text: Respectfully: every cycle top looked exactly like this feed. Green screens are sentiment, not signal — enjoy the run, size for the reversal.
Chain abstraction is a solid thesis, but adoption tracks liquidity cycles, not roadmaps. Building through the quiet macro is the actual edge.
